purpose: Additional illustrative stages for the eight-chapter jewellery-making journey. Original generic process imagery, not documentary photographs of Kritarra's workshop.

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: landscape 3:2 cinematic editorial workshop photograph, matching a luxury jewellery-making story. Warm amber side light, deep espresso shadows, aged walnut and brass tools, tactile realistic materials and natural skin, restrained highlights, no glossy AI look. Jewellery throughout is a simple yellow-gold ring with a rectangular emerald-cut green central stone and tiny round white diamond shoulder accents. Scene centers within the middle 70% for responsive crops. No writing, branding, logos, watermark, borders or collages. Scene: a designer and client seated across a walnut jewellery-design desk, shown only from shoulders to hands, no identifiable faces. Two natural hands discuss a large ivory sketchbook with an emerald-ring drawing, an open small black jewellery box and loose stones on a cream tray. A pencil points to a ring design. Personal, thoughtful consultation, candid luxury editorial composition.
